acceptance.note: Qualification on three old development scenes, not WAM success or unseen generalization. No retuning defaults from these outcomes.

notes: True successful native state/opening references only; same OSC and H40/execute8 Action128 oracle interface.
Each mode restores its own environment. Three tasks, init0, seed42, six complete600-step CPU trials.
Adapter inputs are only current measured opening, existing motor target, previous actual command, generated scalar reference and past interval.
Object/contact/native success are measured after commands solely as metrics and never passed to the adapter.
Native zero holds the existing motor position target. Closing preload is not a calibrated force.
Pre-execution review fix caps closing tolerance at half preload so default motor deadband cannot cancel the declared offset.
